title: Use during installation, repairs, maintenance, adjustments, or removal.
officialText:
Only personnel, materials, and uses
authorized by the person responsible for supervising the installation, repair, maintenance, adjustment, or removal of a
scaffold shall be located on and using the scaffold during such work.
